scope: Independent core, native runtime/JSON, browser diagnostic validation/rendering and MSL compatibility for the cranking-to-running Input spark handoff and simultaneous coordinate/input-fault repair. Excludes full coupled controller parity and acquisition electrical/target timing qualification.

off_serialized_observation_parity.scope: Actual selector Off output observations; not a whole-engine historical replay

findings.description: Resetting Spark Input qualification on every cranking select forced new qualification after a stable contact crossed into running, cutting the whole controller.
findings.resolution: Every valid Input rule steps its actual filter once; cranking Spark always returns valid inactive CrankingBypass. A fresh qualified sample can select normally at run entry.

findings.description: A running coordinate guard returned before observing a simultaneous invalid switch, leaving prior cranking qualification usable on the next healthy call.
findings.reproduction: Prime at 1000000/1010000/1020000 us while cranking; first running call at 1025000 us has unavailable MAP and an invalid switch; at 1030000 us both recover. The initial patch immediately selected secondary with retained qualification.
findings.resolution: Observe every valid Input rule before load-coordinate guards, preserve RequiredMap/Tps/Emap precedence, and reuse the one observed state for selection. Independent checks cover Fuel/Spark, MAP/TPS/EMAP, and invalid/unavailable/future/stale input combinations.

semantics_verified: Cranking keeps secondary Spark inactive and uses the primary cranking angle for every secondary mode; invalid or absent switch does not add an input dependency during the bypass.
Initial qualification uses elapsed observed sample time; repeating a held sample cannot complete a debounce interval.
20 ms sample age and intersample gap are accepted inclusively;20 ms + 1 us invalidates freshness or restarts qualification.
Future samples, backward sample/now times and contradictory equal-time samples reset qualification.
Invalid/unavailable input, source changes, channel/debounce/polarity/rule changes, and Off transitions cannot leak prior qualification.
Fuel and Spark retain independent debounce/polarity state for distinct and shared channels.
An already qualified contact entering pending debounce retains its previous stable selection across cranking/run reentry; initial unqualified bounce inhibits until stable.
Static load sensor requirements and whole-controller running fault cuts remain in force.

Schema/layout fields remain unchanged; qualified inactive CrankingBypass diagnostics pass native and actual Chrome validation and rendering, and seven runtime records retain native/browser 188-column MSL parity.
limitations: Target-protected source values in portable C++ fixtures test software provenance transitions only; they are not target hardware measurements.
Native runtime synthetic intake remains synthetic; no GPIO/I2C hardware or physical engine is exercised.
This review does not establish circuit, HIL, physical, ideal-tune, full Speeduino parity, whole-feature or coupled-matrix qualification.
The parent full native/target build and coupled integration reviews remain separate; no claim is made for their completion.
